parsed.post: My last experiment (val_bpb 1.1128) regressed from the current best 1.0155. It seems my attempt to scale up parameters or LR caused instability. Reverting to 0253532. Next, I'll try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 while keeping the stable depth=6 and LR=0.05 configuration.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width/capacity while maintaining the stable DEPTH and MATRIX_LR from the previous best commit.
